name: Easter Sunday
overview: Easter Sunday marks the triumphant resurrection of Jesus Christ, as witnessed by Mary Magdalene and others who came to the tomb early on the first day of the week and found the stone rolled away. This event fulfills the prophecy of Isaiah 53:5, highlighting Christ’s suffering and the healing brought through His wounds. Jesus declares Himself as the resurrection and the life, promising eternal life to all who believe in Him, affirming the victory over death and the foundation of Christian hope.
